effect.fr: Tenu: Le porteur a 10% de chance de survivre aux attaques ou aux contrecoups de 1 PV.
effect.en: Held: Holder has 10% chance to survive attacks or self-inflicted damage at 1 HP.

flavor.en: An item to be held by a Pokémon. The holder may endure a potential KO attack, leaving it with just 1 HP.
flavor.ko: 지니게 하면 기절할 듯한 기술을 받아도 HP를 1 남겨서 견디기도 한다.
flavor.ja: 持たせると ひんしに なりそうな 技を 受けても ＨＰを １だけ 残して 耐えることが ある。
